description: Get the latest COT positioning snapshot across all tracked futures contracts, grouped by category (Agriculture, Energy, Metals, Equity Indices, Interest Rates, Currencies). Shows commercial and non-commercial net positions in contract counts from the legacy futures-only COT report (positions as of each Tuesday, published Friday). Each row carries the market code accepted by GetCftcPositioning.

category.description: Category filter: Agriculture, Energy, Metals, EquityIndices, InterestRates, Currencies (defaults to all)

title: Latest CFTC Positioning Snapshot
